en.bilal-muhammad: Abu’l Qasim al-Hasan b. Muhammad al-Sakuni narrated to us. He said: Al-Hadrami narrated to us. He said: Yahya al-Hamani narrated to us. He said: Abu `Awana narrated to us from Abu Balaj from `Amr b. Maymun from Ibn `Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said: “
`Ali is the master of every believer after me.”
